name: Evelyn Regner - Considérant 18 - Am 104
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on Business in Europe: Framework for Income Taxation (BEFIT)
part_text: (18) To ensure that the rules of the common framework are implemented and enforced correctly, Member States should lay down rules on penalties applicable to infringements of national provisions adopted pursuant to this Directive. Such penalties should be effective, proportionate and dissuasive.Member States shall remain solely competent to define the system and level of penalties applicable, in accordance with their respective legal traditions.
